name: Rumia (Poland)
description: Blue field with a white line running from the hoist to the fly for the Zagórska Struga stream, with the city arms towards the hoist.
history: Polish gmina flags are established by resolution of the gmina council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.

features.role: line for the Zagórska Struga stream
